tasks: Audit development source-to-sensor reconstruction with name-aligned absolute-difference, signed-difference and mean gains; compare crop, affine scaling and residuals. Source arrays are evaluator-only diagnostics.
Quantify released coupling contributions and changes under zero/donor/permuted connectivity. Any stronger coupling is a labeled synthetic stress condition, not a correction or clinical calibration.

If observation semantics are supported, implement a bounded observation-only fit with explicit priors and withheld temporal blocks or separate conditions. No hidden patient parameters may initialize or tune the fit.
Report prediction, identifiability, network sensitivity and failures before considering a larger intervention benchmark.
fitting_gate: Observation semantics and train/validation partition must be documented before fitting; no claim of independent recording validation from a temporal split.
intervention_gate: Do not repeat or enlarge the oracle intervention benchmark unless the observation-only fit and network sensitivity justify it.
resource_policy: Existing GCP CPUs only. No GPU, provisioning, other jobs, paid model calls or IDEAS download retries. Preserve v1 outputs.
